reviews.title: Great idea, frustrating lack of features
reviews.text: Been using this app for 3 years, and Alhamduillah i can say its great to have as a spot checker, but its been extremely frustrating to see that over the years community request to make the app more functional for someone really trying to use the app to work on their hifz go unnoticed and not implemented. Things like ui backgrounds that match mushaf colors, self marking, word by word translation has not been added. I get the team has added other community and memorizing streaks over the years, but these ask are not large undertaking like tajweed detection. They should be practical enough that the team should be able to answer the request of users, even if not perfect to everyone’s likings. I so badly want to come back and update this review in the future, but for now the frustration with having to take screenshots or have multiple apps open is mounting.

reviews.title: Unfortunate
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, Tarteel has been a let down. It picks up mistakes where there aren’t mistakes and doesn’t pick up mistakes where there are. You could get away with reading a qaaf as a kaaf or changing a Harkat and it would not pick it up, yet double back on yourself and it’ll count all of it as “extra words”.

The app freezes when you try to play a recording and don’t get me started on the test section. It is so faulty. I tried the 7 day trial and I was very disappointed; I am concerned for those who are paying and are praying the Quran wrong and are not being corrected by an app which claims to correct. This is a big amanah.

I don’t normally leave reviews, but as this is a tool which is trying to be used to help students of hifdh and the Quran, I felt I had to say something. 

May Allah accept your efforts, please try and correct the faults of the app. Jazakallah khair

reviews.title: Terrible execution of an amazing idea
reviews.text:
In concept, the app is fantastic and a real game changer, however it’s terrible to use. 

First and foremost, how is there not a Quran button on the homepage? How do I get to the Quran to read? I never close the app because I always forget how to get to the making feature of the app. 

It is so aggressive in detecting mistakes that it makes reading very frustrating, constantly being interrupted by that ‘mistake’ sound. I know for a fact what I’m saying is correct, yet it constantly tells me I’m incorrect, and so I no longer trust it. It doesn’t have many scenarios thought out. For example, if I stop mid-Ayah to take a break and then go back a few words to resume the ayah, it detects it as a mistake rather than an it anticipating that this is how the Quran is read. If I want to repeat the surah I just read, it detects it as a mistake and only considers I should go on to the next surah, which is annoying if I’m driving and trying to read because then it means I have to keep looking at the phone to interact with it. 

The UI of the app is without a doubt the worst of any app I’ve used. Even if I wasn’t a UX designer, it is so clear this app has been designed by AI and is plagued by useless features. It took me so long to understand how to switch between surah, and how to pick up from where I left off. The text is too small, and the nothing is clear. Accessibility has not been considered, and if I was over 40 it would be impossible to navigate. Please take notes from the Dhikr an

reviews.title: Pay for Privacy???
reviews.text:
This app stores the recordings of your voice on their cloud servers and trains their AI on it. If you wish to disable having AI train on your voice, you must pay a monthly subscription. 
While this may be a useful app this is completely unacceptable and invades your right to privacy.
I am very disappointed.
But if the developers change it to allow you to be able to opt out of AI training and opt out of having your recording be stored on their cloud server without a subscription, I would definitely recommend this app to everyone.

reviews.title: The app is terrible
reviews.text: I’ve had the app for a while now and I understand AI is new so I was hoping it would improve over time, but it’s honestly the exact same from when I got it. There’s been no effort to make the AI more accurate in picking up mistakes/what’s being recited correctly. For example when I recite something correctly the ai thinks it’s a mistake and beeps alerting me, but then corrects itself when it realises I said it right. This seems minor but when ur trying to revise multiple pages, this beep completely kills concentration, and it’s irritating when it happens numerous times per session. Avoid this AI for now I’m sure better ones will come out, it’s all influencer hype.

reviews.title: Disappointing Support and Billing Practices
reviews.text:
I was charged for 15 months of membership without using the app even once. When I contacted Tarteel for a refund, they were completely unhelpful and hid behind the excuse that “Apple handles refunds, not us,” instead of taking any responsibility.

This feels misleading and unfair to users. I strongly recommend avoiding this app and looking for better alternatives, especially for apps in this category where trust really matters.
